title: The Summoning
era_role: Seconda traccia, singolo del 6 gennaio 2023. Rituale di evocazione in tre tempi: furia metallica, lamento celeste, coda funk e R&B. È anche il brano che porta la band al pubblico di massa.
in_character_quotes_gap_reason: Nel 2023 Vessel non ha rilasciato interviste traccia-per-traccia. Le cover story di Kerrang! e Metal Hammer sul ciclo Eden sono saggi critici, non interviste al personaggio.

editorial_reading.summary: La stampa (Kerrang!, Metal Hammer, NME, Revolver) descrive il passaggio dal progressive metalcore allo shoegaze e poi a una coda funk-soul, letta come la voce seduttiva di Sleep.
editorial_reading.source_title: Louder - The story behind every Sleep Token song (Page 3)

editorial_reading.summary: [riferimento testuale] and [riferimento testuale] were the first two singles, released on 5 and 6 January 2023 respectively.[4] These were followed by "Granite[riferimento testuale]Aqua Regia" on 20 January.[5]
editorial_reading.source_title: Wikipedia - Take Me Back to Eden

editorial_reading.summary: Take Me Back to Eden debuted number 3 in the UK and number 16 on the US Billboard 200.[22][23] The second single [riferimento testuale] was the band's first song to register on the official UK and US charts, reaching number 14 on the UK Rock & Metal Singles Chart,[24] number 26 on the Billboard Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart,[25] and number two on the Billboard Hard Rock Digital Song Sales chart.[26][22][27][28]
editorial_reading.source_title: Wikipedia - Take Me Back to Eden

editorial_reading.summary: TikTok interest around singles like Chokehold and The Summoning certainly helped spread Sleep Token's message, but the fact that Take Me Back To Eden felt like a full circle moment for the band - both musically and thematically, ensured it was one of the biggest metal releases of 2023, as well as being voted the best metal album of 2023 by Metal Hammer readers.
editorial_reading.source_title: Louder / Metal Hammer - The story behind every Sleep Token song (Page 4)

editorial_reading.summary: Another reference to a chemical reaction: Aqua Regia is a scientific compound used to refine gold. There’s a lot of gold imagery in the song’s lyrics, as well as a suggestion of the of drug abuse hinted at in Granite (and referring to blood trails from The Summoning).
editorial_reading.source_title: Louder / Metal Hammer - The story behind every Sleep Token song (Page 4)

symbols.creature: Guerriero corazzato in una caverna rossa, con una grande alabarda o ascia bipenne incisa di rune.
symbols.ritual_role: Guardiano dell'evocazione: forza seduttiva e marziale insieme.
symbols.object: Alabarda runica, fiume rosso, cielo squarciato
symbols.sigil_gap_reason: I 12 sigilli geometrici appartengono a Sundowning (Capitolo 1). In Take Me Back to Eden il sistema simbolico è il cifrario runico e le 12 creature.
symbols.depth_gap_reason: La batimetria marina appartiene a TPWBYT (Capitolo 2). Dopo la riemersione di Chokehold l'ambientazione è terrestre, lunare e alchemica.

references.detail: Nel lessico teurgico l'evocazione richiama la divinità nel corpo del tramite per oltrepassare il confine tra terra e cielo.
references.supporting_phrase: Richiesta di essere sollevato oltre il proprio limite fino a vedere l'altro lato.

callbacks.motif: Inverte Levitate, dove l'ascesa era negata, e occupa lo slot rituale della traccia 2, come The Offering e Hypnosis.
callbacks.source_title: Sleep Token Collective Wiki - The Summoning

community_theories.theory: La coda funk dopo il silenzio ambient viene letta come un cambio di narratore: prima l'invocazione di Vessel, poi la risposta sensuale di Sleep.
community_theories.source_title: Boolin Tunes - The Lore of Sleep Token

community_theories.theory: The Summoning is the second track and second single from Sleep Token's third album, Take Me Back To Eden. The Summoning released on January 6th, 2023 with it's official video.
community_theories.source_title: Sleep Token Collective Wiki - The Summoning

community_theories.theory: The Summoning was officially certified Platinum in the Untited States by RIAA (Recording Industry Association Of America) with 1 million equivalent units on April 10th, 2026.[1]
community_theories.source_title: Sleep Token Collective Wiki - The Summoning

community_theories.theory: In many instances when The Summoning is performed live, during the guitar solo part, Vessel will start messing around on stage, usually with band members or crew members.[2]
community_theories.source_title: Sleep Token Collective Wiki - The Summoning
